problem.title: Constant acceleration
problem.statement: A body falls from rest for 2 seconds at 9.81 m/s^2 with no drag. Return displacement in metres as the numeric answer.

problem.title: Kinetic energy
problem.statement: A 3 kg mass moves at 4 m/s. Return kinetic energy in joules as the numeric answer.

problem.title: Ohm law
problem.statement: A resistor has resistance 12 ohm and voltage 6 V. Return current in A as the numeric answer.

problem.title: Period
problem.statement: A periodic wave has frequency 25 Hz. Return period in seconds as numeric answer.

problem.title: Dimensional analysis
problem.statement: What are the base dimensions of energy? Format the string answer as M^a L^b T^c, replacing a, b, c with integer exponents.

problem.title: Limiting case
problem.statement: For x != 0, f(x)=sin(x)/x in radians. Return the limit as x approaches 0 as numeric answer.

problem.title: Independent events
problem.statement: Two fair independent coin tosses occur. Return the probability of two heads as numeric answer.

problem.title: Inconsistent premises
problem.statement: An isolated system has no energy input/output, and its total energy doubles without any change in the definition of total energy. Are these premises consistent with energy conservation? Answer consistent or inconsistent.

problem.title: Missing source
problem.statement: No papers or experimental data are supplied. A statement claims material X exceeds all measured superconducting temperatures. Is this established by the supplied evidence? Answer supported or insufficient_evidence.

problem.title: Code repair
problem.statement: Repair this Python function so it adds one: def increment(x): return x - 1. Return the corrected function source in the answer field. Do not execute code.

problem.title: Symbolic derivative
problem.statement: Find d(x^3)/dx. Use the exact compact expression in the answer string with * and ** operators, without spaces.

problem.title: Independent uncertainty
problem.statement: Two independent measurements have standard uncertainties 3 and 4 units and are summed. Return the combined standard uncertainty as numeric answer.
